name: php-bencode-cli
title: PHP Bencode CLI
blurb: Bencode encoder/decoder in PHP: integers, byte strings, lists and sorted-key dicts, canonical-form validation, JSON on the other side
default_description: A PHP bencode encoder and decoder CLI.

verify.name: encode
verify.cmd: printf '{"a":1,"b":["x"]}' | php bin/{{ npm_name }} encode | grep -qxF 'd1:ai1e1:bl1:xee'

verify.name: decode
verify.cmd: printf 'd1:ai1e1:bl1:xee' | php bin/{{ npm_name }} decode | grep -qxF '{"a":1,"b":["x"]}'

verify.name: canonical
verify.cmd: printf 'i03e' | php bin/{{ npm_name }} decode >/dev/null 2>&1; test $? -eq 1
